name: phantomguard
description: PhantomGuard: a client-side static security analyzer for Terraform, Dockerfiles and IAM policies, wrapped in a haunted web playground. Kiroween 2026, Costume Contest.

scripts.build: npm run build:engine && npm run build:cli && npm run build:web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:engine && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.audit:precommit: npm run audit:governance && npm run audit:secrets && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.clean: node -e "for (const d of ['packages/core-engine/dist','packages/cli-toolkit/dist','packages/web-playground/dist']) require('node:fs').rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true })"
